nodes.name: From Hub-Dispatcher (health.scored)
nodes.notes: S6.3 — previously a Daily 8AM schedule trigger polling every active-project client. Now Dispatcher-triggered off event_type: health.scored (from 6.1.1's S6.1 report), same input shape as every other Dispatcher-called spoke (event_type, client_id, odoo_lead_id, source_module, payload). This turns a daily full-table scan into a per-client check that only runs when that client's health score actually changes.

parameters.query:
-- S6.3: scoped to the single client from the health.scored event, not a full active-project scan
SELECT id AS client_id, odoo_project_id, odoo_discuss_channel_id, name, email, odoo_lead_id
FROM clients_master
WHERE id = {{ $json.client_id }}
  AND odoo_project_id IS NOT NULL
  AND status IN ('Onboarded', 'Active/Onboarded (recurring)', 'Churn Risk')
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Get Client's Active Project
nodes.notes: S6.3 — renamed from 'Get Clients With Active Projects' (was a LIMIT 100 batch fetch across all clients); now LIMIT 1 keyed on the client_id the Dispatcher passed in. Returns nothing if the client has no odoo_project_id or isn't in an active status — downstream nodes will just see an empty result and no alert fires, same as today's 'no overdue tasks' path.

nodes.name: Scheduled Check - Overdue Tasks (Odoo)
nodes.notes: 6.2.2.1 (part 2). Uses project.task.date_deadline vs stage_id.is_closed via execute_kw, same JSON-RPC pattern as every other Odoo call in this stack. FLAG: 6.2.1's checklist tasks are created WITHOUT a date_deadline today, so this node will only catch tasks that had a deadline set some other way (manually by the delivery team, or a future patch to 6.2.1). Also flags the same Odoo-version ambiguity already on record elsewhere in this plan (stage_id.is_closed availability / project.milestone vs project.task) - confirm against the live Odoo version before relying on this field name.

nodes.name: Missed? (has overdue tasks)
nodes.notes: 6.2.2.2. Alert branch fires only when the search returned at least one overdue, non-closed task for this client's project.

nodes.name: Odoo Discuss Alert (internal team)
nodes.notes: 6.2.2.3 (part 1). Posts to the same per-client Discuss channel Module 2.7 already creates (odoo_discuss_channel_id). Uses 'discuss.channel' model - same version caveat already flagged repeatedly in this plan (mail.channel on Odoo <17, discuss.channel on 17+) - confirm against the live instance.

nodes.name: Email Alert (Postal, internal fallback)
nodes.notes: 6.2.2.3 (part 2). Internal delivery-team alert, NOT sent to the client - this is a missed-milestone notice for Nivy's own team to act on. 'delivery-team@nivynext.internal' is a placeholder recipient address - confirm the real distribution list before production.

subSteps.6.2.2.1: Scheduled check node (milestone due-date vs status) -> From Hub-Dispatcher (health.scored) + Get Client's Active Project + Scheduled Check - Overdue Tasks (Odoo). S6.3: switched from Daily 8AM polling to Dispatcher-triggered, per-client.
subSteps.6.2.2.2: IF node - missed -> alert branch -> Missed? (has overdue tasks)
subSteps.6.2.2.3: Odoo Discuss/email alert node -> Format Alert Message + Odoo Discuss Alert + Email Alert (Postal fallback)
